اقتلعتن (form VIII)
# اِقْتَلَعْتُنَّ (iqtalaʕtunna) /iq.ta.laʕ.tun.na/: second-person feminine plural past active of اِقْتَلَعَ (iqtalaʕa)
# اُقْتُلِعْتُنَّ (uqtuliʕtunna) /uq.tu.liʕ.tun.na/: second-person feminine plural past passive of اِقْتَلَعَ (iqtalaʕa)
